High-speed car crash in Thane kills two

A BMW traveling at an estimated 250-251 kmph collided with a divider in Thane, resulting in a severe accident. The impact caused the car to break apart, with the engine reportedly landing 30 meters away. Two individuals returning from a party died in the incident, and at least one other person was injured.
